source_text: These appeals aimed to harness the moral and diplomatic authority of supranational entities to pressure governments into legislative reforms, emphasizing empirical evidence of long-term physical and psychological harms documented in symposium proceedings, such as increased risks of infection, sexual dysfunction, and trauma.
